_about: 100-point profile rubric. 'auto' criteria are scored by profile_audit.py from the snapshot; 'manual' criteria need eyes (the agent scores them from a screenshot or description and passes them with --manual). Every criterion lists what full marks looks like, so a score can always be explained.

criteria.label: Profile photo
criteria.full_marks: Face (or a simple logo for a brand) that is recognisable at 110 px: tight crop, plain or contrasting background, no text.

criteria.label: Username
criteria.full_marks: Short, spellable after hearing it once, no random digits, at most one separator.

criteria.label: Name field
criteria.full_marks: Contains the phrase people search for (the name field is searchable), not just a repeat of the username.

criteria.label: Bio clarity
criteria.full_marks: Who it is for, what they get, one proof point, one next step, inside 150 characters. Scored with the shared bio rubric.

criteria.label: Bio call to action
criteria.full_marks: Ends with one action that points at the link or a DM keyword.

criteria.label: Link
criteria.full_marks: At least one link, and the bio says what is behind it.

criteria.label: Highlights
criteria.full_marks: 3-7 highlights, short titles, including a start-here / offer / proof highlight.

criteria.label: Pinned posts
criteria.full_marks: Three pinned posts that do three jobs: who I am, best value post, proof or offer.

criteria.label: Content consistency
criteria.full_marks: 80%+ of the last 9-12 posts sit inside the declared content pillars.

criteria.label: Positioning
criteria.full_marks: A first-time visitor can say in one sentence why this account and not the obvious alternative.
